item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: make this pic talk in a video

dialog.agent:
I can make your photo talk, but I need two things from you first:

1. **What should be said, word for word? Or should I write it from the gist?**
2. **Do you have a voice recording for her to speak?** The talking-photo tool moves her lips to match an audio file you upload, like an MP3, WAV or M4A. It can't create a voice from typed text. If you don't have a recording, I can make her speak your words with a generated voice instead. Her face and the background may change a little that way.

Also, please confirm this is you or someone who has agreed to have their photo animated. I can only make talking videos of people who've given permission.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user for the script wording and whether they have a voice recording, and asks them to confirm consent, then waits for answers before making anything.
dialog.user: say exactly: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new." and ya it's me in the pic

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for it. Nothing was made and no credits were used.

Since you don't have a voice recording, I set it up so you'd speak your exact line with a generated voice: *"Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new."* It was set for 5 seconds at 480p, the most the free plan allows.

You have two ways to get it made:
- **Add credits** with a credit pack or an upgrade. Tell me when that's done and I'll start the same video right away.
- **Upload a recording of yourself saying the line.** Then I can use the talking-photo tool, which moves the lips in your photo to match your real voice. It still needs credits, though, so this alone won't fix the problem.
